Company Profile

About Roohiluna

Roohiluna is the consumer-facing brand of Roohiluna Handicrafts, a business focused on handcrafted, handwoven lampshades and decorative lighting. Our products bring together artisan skill, distinctive textures, carefully selected colours, and contemporary design.

We work with wholesale buyers, retailers, distributors, interior designers, hospitality businesses, and project purchasers. Our priority markets include Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, and other Gulf countries, while we also welcome enquiries from buyers worldwide.

Our Mission

To share the value of handcrafted artistry with international customers through distinctive products, clear communication, and dependable wholesale service.

Our Craftsmanship

Each lampshade is handcrafted. Small variations in weaving, texture, colour, finish, and dimensions may occur between pieces. These natural variations are characteristics of handmade products. Product photographs are illustrative; screen settings and lighting may affect how colours appear.

Wholesale, MOQ & Sample Policy

Minimum Order Quantity

Our standard minimum order quantity is 20 pieces per order. Buyers may combine variants/designs within the order, provided the total order reaches 20 pieces and the requested assortment is confirmed in writing by Roohiluna. Any design-specific restrictions, availability limits, or customisation requirements will be stated in the quotation.

Samples and Free Sample Shipping

Buyers may request samples to evaluate the craftsmanship, colour, materials, and finish before placing a wholesale order. Roohiluna offers free shipping for eligible sample orders, subject to confirmation of the sample, destination, shipping method, and any applicable conditions before dispatch. Unless agreed otherwise in writing, customs duties, import taxes, clearance charges, and other fees imposed in the destination country are the buyer’s responsibility.

Free Shipping for First Three Orders

Roohiluna offers free shipping on the first three qualifying wholesale orders from a new customer, subject to written confirmation in the quotation or pro forma invoice. Eligibility, order scope, destination, shipping method, package limits, and any exclusions must be confirmed by Roohiluna before the order is accepted. Unless expressly agreed in writing, this offer covers the agreed freight/shipping charge only and excludes customs duties, import taxes, destination clearance fees, storage fees, and other government or third-party charges.

Free-shipping offers cannot be combined with other promotions unless Roohiluna confirms otherwise in writing. Roohiluna may clarify or amend promotional terms for future orders, but will honour terms already confirmed for an accepted order.

Wholesale Enquiries

Please email sales@roohiluna.com with your company name, destination country, requested designs/variants, quantity, required dimensions, customisation needs, and delivery postcode/city. We will provide a quotation and confirm the MOQ, production timeline, payment terms, packaging, and shipping arrangements.

Terms & Conditions

Effective date: 17 October 2026

Orders and Acceptance

An order is accepted only when Roohiluna confirms it in writing and the required payment or deposit has been received. The quotation or pro forma invoice will specify the product, variants, quantity, price, currency, payment terms, estimated production timeline, and shipping arrangement. Buyers must review these details before paying.

Pricing and Payment

Prices are in the currency stated in the quotation. Unless expressly included, prices exclude taxes, customs duties, import charges, and shipping. Payment milestones, deposit requirements, and balance due dates are those shown in the accepted quotation or pro forma invoice. Production may begin only after the required initial payment clears.

Handmade Variations

As products are handcrafted, minor variations in colour, weave, texture, finish, and dimensions may occur. These variations are not automatically defects. Any critical tolerances or special specifications must be agreed in writing before production.

Production and Delivery

Production and transit dates are estimates unless expressly guaranteed in writing. Timelines may be affected by order quantity, customisation, material availability, artisan capacity, customs, carriers, weather, or other events outside our reasonable control. Roohiluna will communicate material delays when reasonably practicable.

Changes and Cancellation

Requests to change or cancel an order must be made in writing. Changes are subject to approval and may affect price or delivery. Once production or custom procurement has begun, cancellation may not be possible; where permitted by law, the buyer may be responsible for reasonable costs already incurred. Any accepted cancellation and refund terms will be confirmed in writing.

Intellectual Property

Unless agreed otherwise in writing, Roohiluna retains rights in its original designs, product photographs, brand identity, catalogues, and other intellectual property. These materials may not be copied, reproduced, or commercially used without written permission.

Liability and Force Majeure

To the extent permitted by applicable law, Roohiluna is not liable for indirect or consequential losses. Nothing in these terms excludes liability or legal rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Roohiluna is not responsible for delay or non-performance caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, transport disruption, government restrictions, labour disruption, or supply-chain interruptions.

Governing Law

The governing law and dispute forum should be stated in the final contract or accepted quotation, taking account of the registered business and the buyer’s location. Nothing in these terms removes mandatory legal protections that apply to a transaction.

Shipping & Delivery Policy

Markets Served

Roohiluna welcomes international orders, with priority outreach to Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Jordan, other Gulf countries, and buyers worldwide.

Shipping Charges and Promotions

Sample shipping is free for eligible samples when confirmed in writing. Shipping is also offered free for a new customer’s first three qualifying wholesale orders when the offer is confirmed in writing. For other orders, shipping will be quoted separately unless the accepted quotation states otherwise. The quotation will identify the agreed shipping method and any exclusions.

Customs, Duties and Taxes

For international shipments, the buyer is responsible for import permits, customs clearance, duties, taxes, and destination fees unless the quotation expressly states otherwise. Buyers should check their country’s import requirements before ordering. Roohiluna will provide agreed commercial documents, such as an invoice and packing list, as applicable.

Packaging and Inspection

Roohiluna takes reasonable care to package products for transport. Buyers needing special export packaging should request it before order confirmation; additional charges may apply. Please inspect the parcel promptly on arrival.

Damage or Delivery Issues

If a shipment arrives damaged or incorrect, contact sales@roohiluna.com as soon as possible, ideally within 48 hours of delivery. Include the order number, photographs of the product and outer packaging, and a description of the issue. Please retain packaging where practical. The suggested 48-hour period helps us investigate promptly and does not remove any rights that cannot be excluded by law.

Delivery Estimates

Dispatch and delivery dates are estimates unless expressly agreed otherwise in writing. Delays may arise from customs inspections, courier disruption, weather, public holidays, or other factors outside our reasonable control.

Returns, Refunds & No-Return Policy

Roohiluna’s standard policy for wholesale and made-to-order products is that sales are final and returns are not accepted for change of mind. This policy is subject to applicable law and does not remove any mandatory rights or remedies.

Non-Returnable Reasons

Damaged, Defective or Incorrect Goods

If products arrive damaged, materially defective, or materially different from the agreed specifications, notify Roohiluna promptly with the order reference, description, and photographs. After review, Roohiluna will determine an appropriate remedy—such as repair, replacement, credit, or refund—in accordance with the circumstances, the accepted order terms, and applicable law.

Refunds

Where a refund is approved, it will normally be made through the original payment method where practical. Processing times depend on the payment provider or financial institution.

Contact for Claims

Email sales@roohiluna.com and use the subject line “Order Claim – [Order Number]”.

  • Change of mind after order confirmation.
  • A buyer’s incorrect selection of quantity, variant, colour, or design where the product matches the approved order.
  • Minor handmade variations in colour, weave, texture, finish, or dimensions that are consistent with the agreed specifications.
  • Differences between a screen image and the actual colour caused by lighting, photography, or display settings.
  • Custom or made-to-order products after production has commenced, except where law requires otherwise.

Privacy Policy

Effective date: 17 October 2026

Information We Collect

We may collect names, company details, email addresses, phone numbers, billing and shipping addresses, order specifications, correspondence, transaction records, and information needed for shipping, customs, accounting, and legal compliance.

How We Use Information

We use information to respond to enquiries, issue quotations, process samples and orders, arrange production and delivery, provide customer support, maintain business records, prevent fraud, and meet legal obligations. Marketing messages will be sent only where permitted by applicable law.

Sharing and International Transfers

We may share necessary information with courier companies, freight forwarders, customs brokers, payment providers, website and IT providers, professional advisers, and authorities where legally required. International orders may involve transferring relevant information across borders, with safeguards where required by law. We do not sell personal information.

Security and Retention

We take reasonable measures to protect information, but no electronic system can be guaranteed completely secure. Information is retained only as long as reasonably necessary for business, contractual, dispute-resolution, and legal purposes.

Your Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of eligible personal information, object to certain processing, or withdraw consent where processing relies on consent. Contact sales@roohiluna.com to submit a request.

Cookies and Third-Party Services

Our website may use necessary cookies and, where permitted, analytics or other cookies to improve functionality and understand website usage. Where required, consent will be requested for non-essential cookies. Third-party websites have their own privacy practices.
